comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks an impact damper; pr-1495 produces a sound 200 mm L-shaped TIG seam and returns both tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines recessed setscrew tool insertion, counterholding, fine collar adjustment, bounded tightening, and test cycling. pr-1495 requires continuous bimanual torch tracking and timed filler-rod dabbing while maintaining arc clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate succeeds after two safe stopping cycles and a post-lock retention check. pr-1495 requires all 40 seam segments sound, no contamination or burn-through, and both tools released on their rests.
comparison.reason: Both use tools and bimanual coordination, but the mechanisms and outcomes are materially different: mechanical parameter commissioning versus coordinated seam formation. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, lock-torque, and drift thresholds.
